examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The 6-digit authenticator code in a `Field`: type, paste or autofill it; `complete` fires when the last box fills.

examples.name: Grouped
examples.summary: `group` draws a separator every 3 or 4 boxes without changing the value; `mode="alphanumeric"` keeps letters and digits in upper case for an 8-character recovery code.

examples.name: States
examples.summary: Invalid after a rejected code (danger borders, `aria-invalid`, the reason in the description) and disabled while the code is checked.
